notes:
Root cause: my test files never used the constants. The missing-name came from the shared helpers. In bookmarks/tests/helpers.py:182-183, setup_bundle uses BookmarkBundle.FILTER_STATE_OFF as a default argument, and Python evaluates that when the module is imported. bookmarks/tests_e2e/helpers.py:6 imports that module too. So once the app code is taken out, importing either helper crashes before any test runs. I'm not allowed to edit those helpers.

Fix: both files no longer import bookmarks.tests.helpers or bookmarks.tests_e2e.helpers. This departs from the strategy's rule to use LinkdingApiTestCase, BookmarkFactoryMixin and LinkdingE2ETestCase, and I'm noting it here with the reason: the shared helpers can't be imported without the change. Each file now has a small local copy of only the helper code it uses:
- API file: BundleFilterStateTestMixin on rest_framework APITestCase. It covers user and token auth, get/post/put/patch, setup_bookmark, setup_tag, setup_bundle, make_soup, and assertVisibleBookmarks / assertInvisibleBookmarks.
- E2E file: BundleFilterStateE2ETestCase on LiveServerTestCase. It covers login cookie, Playwright open and teardown, numbered bookmarks, setup_bundle, locate_bookmark and count_bookmarks.
- The local setup_bundle only sets fields that existed before the change, so the model's default applies.
- Neither file references FILTER_* constants or the model's filter fields. Values are checked only through API JSON, labels, option text and the preview text.

Other change: test_bookmarks_api_bundle_without_states_matches_all_states passed both with and without the change, which breaks the strategy's rule that a test must fail without the change. I folded it into test_create_bundle_without_states_defaults_to_off. That test creates a bundle through the API without the new fields, checks that GET returns "off" for both, then checks that ?bundle= returns read, unread, shared and unshared bookmarks. The API file now has 10 tests and the e2e file has 2.

Results with the change:
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider bookmarks/tests/test_bundle_filters_blind_api.py` → "10 passed in 1.94s"
- `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -o "python_files=e2e_test_*.py" bookmarks/tests_e2e/e2e_test_bundle_filters_blind.py` → "2 passed in 5.66s"
- `ruff format` → "1 file reformatted, 1 file left unchanged"; `ruff check` → "All checks passed!"

Without the change: traced but not run, so I have not verified this part. I made a temporary worktree at HEAD~1 and copied both files into it, but the shell couldn't change into that directory. Running pytest there from outside only gave 2 collection errors, which came from how I ran it and say nothing about the tests. I removed the worktree; `git status` shows only my two files plus the package-lock.json change that was already there.

My per-test trace of the pre-change code: every test reaches an assertion first.
- API tests fail on assertIn("filter_unread", ...) or on a mismatch in the returned bookmark titles. DRF ignores unknown fields on POST/PUT, so those requests still succeed.
- The list-page test fails on the data-bookmarks-total selector.
- The form tests fail on "No single label 'Reading State' found".
- The e2e tests fail when Playwright's to_be_visible() times out on the Reading State control, which raises AssertionError.

The factory's revert check will be the first real run.
